sentenceSets.sentence: The temporal dimension of the strategy—the question of when, not just what—received less attention than it deserved.

answerChoices.reasoning: Spiritual relates to the soul or eternal realm; the sentence concerns timing and when-related questions, opposite of spiritual.
Eternal means without time or forever; temporal concerns timing and duration, opposite quality.
Abstract is intangible or theoretical; the sentence concerns timing of concrete actions.
Conceptual relates to ideas or concepts but the sentence concerns the practical timing of when actions occur.
Theoretical is about ideas but temporal concerns the practical timing dimension of strategy.
Fundamental means essential but does not specifically relate to time; the sentence concerns timing.
Structural relates to organization but not specifically to timing; the sentence concerns when questions.
Philosophical is theoretical but the sentence concerns practical timing of strategy implementation.
Spatial relates to space; temporal relates to time, opposite domains.
Immaterial means not important or not physical but the sentence shows something receiving less attention than deserved.
Permanent means lasting forever; temporal concerns limited time and duration.

sentenceSets.sentence: The historian's analysis distinguished between temporal changes in fashion and the deeper moral values that remained constant across centuries.

answerChoices.reasoning: Eternal means unchanging forever; the sentence shows temporal changes in fashion, opposite quality.
Universal means applying everywhere at all times but the sentence shows temporal (changing) fashion.
Permanent means not changing; the sentence shows temporal changes contrasted with constant values.
Fundamental means essential and enduring but the sentence contrasts temporal changes with fundamental values.
Superficial means shallow but does not specifically concern time; fashion changes are temporal, not just superficial.
Transient means passing but overlaps with temporal; the sentence emphasizes time-specific changes.
Cyclical means repeating in cycles but temporal changes may not be cyclical, just time-bound.
Evolving means changing gradually but does not specifically emphasize the temporal nature.
Static means not changing but the sentence shows fashion undergoing temporal changes.
Absolute means unconditional; the sentence shows fashion changes that are relative to time.
Infinite means limitless but temporal concerns bounded time and changes within time.

sentenceSets.sentence: The monk renounced temporal concerns—wealth, status, and worldly ambition—to pursue spiritual enlightenment.

answerChoices.reasoning: Physical means bodily or material but the sentence lists wealth and status, which are social/material, and temporal is more specific.
Spiritual relates to the soul; the sentence shows the monk renounced temporal concerns to pursue spiritual goals.
Eternal means lasting forever but the monk renounced transient temporal concerns for spiritual pursuit.
Permanent means lasting but temporal concerns are temporary and worldly.
Societal means relating to society but temporal is broader, including worldly concerns generally.
Material relates to physical matter but temporal is broader, including worldly concerns.
Bureaucratic relates to institutions but does not capture worldly ambitions and concerns.
Professional relates to work but does not encompass all temporal concerns like wealth and status.
Emotional relates to feelings but temporal concerns are worldly matters, not emotional states.
Intellectual relates to the mind but temporal concerns are worldly and material.
Biological relates to life and organisms but temporal concerns are worldly and social.
